messages:
claire_mkt: Quick sync team  aiming to publish the 'Production Inference Benchmarks' blog tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need PR embargo, CEO quote sign-off, and final assets.

tom_pr: Copy. What's the embargo time exactly and the single-sentence pitch for outreach?

claire_mkt: Embargo until 9:00 AM PT. Pitch: 'New Redwood benchmarks reveal clear trade-offs for latency vs cost across common inference workloads.'

anya_eng: Charts + CSVs uploaded to /shared/benchmarks/prod-inference-2026. Use `./scripts/export_pngs.sh` for high-res. Method blurb for press: 'Tests run on representative workloads across three model sizes and two GPU classes; metrics include p95/p99, throughput, and cost/token.'

claire_mkt: Draft CEO quote: "We built Redwood to make inference predictable for teams in production." @kevin_ceo please review.

kevin_ceo: Tiny edit: prefer "...predictable and economical for teams in production." Approve with that change.

jordan_support: Support will standby for the first 3 hours post-publish. Please share the internal FAQ link and triage channel once embargo email goes out.

claire_mkt: FAQ uploaded: https://drive.redwood/support/faq/prod-inference-2026.pdf. Also adding 6 likely Qs to the blog.

anya_eng: CMS frontmatter: add `bench_publish: true` and set staging `noindex: true`. I validated the staging preview.

claire_mkt: @deploy-bot can you schedule CMS publish for 2026-06-15T16:00:00Z (9:00 AM PT) and enforce embargo?

deploy-bot: publish job created: job_id=prodbench-176200, scheduled_time=1762009200, embargo=true. :white_check_mark:

claire_mkt: PR will send embargo email at 4:30 PM PT to the press list and ping top-tier contacts. No public comments until live.

tom_pr: I'll send the embargo and attach Q&A + interview availability at 4:30. Will flag any early asks.

jordan_support: Triage channel: #support-prod-bench-176200. Canned replies uploaded in playbook.

kevin_ceo: Thanks everyone  excited to see this go live. Keep me posted if any reporters request an early interview. :rocket:
